verdict.rationale: GitHub documents an official Copilot CLI with its own install guide that lets you use Copilot directly from your terminal. It also documents local sandboxes where Copilot can work with code, tools and the filesystem on your own machine, which together support running an agent locally from the terminal. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the CLI runs autonomous agentic tasks (plan, edit files, run commands) rather than just chat, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the terminal agent in use.
